actions.name: legendary resistance
actions.desc: If the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: multiattack
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} makes three [[/item Rend]] attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of (A) [[/item Slowing Breath]] or (B) [[/item Spellcasting]] to cast @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplMindSpike0]{Mind Spike} (level 4 version).

actions.name: acid breath
actions.desc: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=qNI6W02jCUQbPpYE]], each [[lookup @target.affects.type activity=qNI6W02jCUQbPpYE]] in a [[lookup @target.template.size activity=qNI6W02jCUQbPpYE]]-foot-long, [[lookup @target.template.width activity=qNI6W02jCUQbPpYE]]-foot-wide Line. Failure: [[/damage average]] damage. Success: [[lookup @damage.onSave capitalize activity=qNI6W02jCUQbPpYE]] damage.

actions.name: spellcasting
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC [[lookup @attributes.spell.dc]]): At Will: @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplDetectMagi]{Detect Magic}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplMindSpike0]{Mind Spike} (level 4 version), @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplMinorIllus]{Minor Illusion}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplShapechang]{Shapechange} (Beast or Humanoid form only, no Temporary Hit Points gained from the spell, and no Concentration or Temporary Hit Points required to maintain the spell) 1/Day Each: @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplGreaterRes]{Greater Restoration}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplMajorImage]{Major Image}

actions.name: giggling magic
actions.desc: Charisma Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=Ttrajc4RC5Ut7pkj]], [[lookup @target.affects.labels.statblock activity=Ttrajc4RC5Ut7pkj]] the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can see within [[lookup @range.value activity=Ttrajc4RC5Ut7pkj]] feet. Failure: [[/damage average]] damage. Until the end of its next turn, the target rolls [[/r 1d6]] whenever it makes an ability check or attack roll and subtracts the number rolled from the D20 Test. Failure or Success: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

actions.name: mind jolt
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} uses Spellcasting to cast @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplMindSpike0]{Mind Spike} (level 4 version). The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

actions.name: pounce
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} moves up to half its Speed, and it makes one [[/item Rend]] attack.

actions.name: slowing breath
actions.desc: Constitution Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=teMMQNDDIE9XkPN3]], each creature in a [[lookup @target.template.size activity=teMMQNDDIE9XkPN3]]-foot Cone. Failure: The target can't take Reactions; its Speed is halved; and it can take either an action or a Bonus Action on its turn, not both. This effect lasts until the end of its next turn.
